email.subject: Keel Group Auto Care: two quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I looked at Keel Group Auto Care's site. Two issues likely costing you customers: it isn't mobile-friendly, so most Harbor Falls drivers searching on their phones have a hard time using it, and there's no click-to-call button, meaning mobile visitors can't tap to ring you and probably just call a competitor instead. The site also has no online booking and a footer with outdated info.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough this week where I show you exactly what's losing calls?

Alex
Northlight Web
